title: Cosmological Collider Signatures from Right-Handed Neutrino Loop
summary: We study cosmological collider (CC) signatures generated by right-handed neutrino loops in the setup of inflation combined with the neutrino seesaw mechanism. We formulate the inflaton interaction with the right-handed neutrinos through a unique dimension-5 operator respecting shift symmetry, which induces an effective chemical potential in the slow-roll background, leading to helicity-dependent production of right-handed neutrinos and enhancing the CC signatures.
